test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the main objective of the Esports Conclave 2025 held in India?

options.text: To promote esports as a serious career and sporting option
To promote board games in schools

solution:
The correct answer is __**To promote esports as a serious career and sporting option**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Esports Conclave 2025** was organized as a landmark event in **India** to address the rapidly evolving landscape of **competitive digital gaming**.
 
• The primary objective of the conclave was to **promote esports** as a legitimate and **serious career path**, moving beyond the perception of gaming as a mere hobby. ***Hence, the correct answer is option 3.***
 
• It aimed to bridge the gap between **professional players**, **investors**, and **policymakers** to establish a robust **sporting ecosystem** within the country.
 
• The event focused on the **professionalization** of the sector, discussing **training modules**, **athlete management**, and the creation of **dedicated infrastructure** for tournaments.
 
• It emphasized the **socio-economic impact** of esports, highlighting how it can generate **employment opportunities** in sectors like **broadcasting**, **event management**, and **game development**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Esports vs. Online Gaming**:
 
 
• **Esports** refers to **skill-based competitive gaming** where individuals or teams compete under a regulated set of rules, similar to traditional sports.
 
• The conclave sought to differentiate this from **casual online gaming** or **gambling**, ensuring a clear **regulatory framework** for competitive integrity.
 
 
 
• **Market Growth in India**:
 
 
• India has become one of the **world's largest markets** for gaming due to the deep **penetration of smartphones** and affordable **mobile data**.
 
• The number of **professional esports players** in India has seen an exponential rise, with **international tournaments** now offering prize pools worth **millions of dollars**.
 
 
 
• **Global Context**:
 
 
• Esports has gained **international recognition**, being featured as a **medal sport** in the **Asian Games 2022** (held in 2023) and the upcoming **Olympic Esports Games**.
 
• Such global milestones have paved the way for **national governments** to include esports in their **national sports policies**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Government Recognition**: In **December 2022**, the **Government of India** officially recognized esports as a part of **"multi-sports events"** under the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• **Skill-Based Development**: The focus of the **2025 Conclave** was also on the **mental and physical well-being** of players, advocating for a holistic approach to **athlete training**.
 
• **Inclusivity**: The conclave discussed **gender inclusivity** in gaming, encouraging more **women participation** in the professional esports arena to diversify the **talent pool**.
 
• **Technological Integration**: Discussions included the role of **5G technology**, **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**, and **Cloud Gaming** in enhancing the competitive experience for Indian athletes.
